Oh, No You Don't! is an exploration achievement earned for chasing an Opportunistic Harrower back to its nest in the Voidstorm. By the time it reaches its nest at , the achievement should be earned.

When Waxy Globules get too close to the lit braziers, they will slowly burn, decreasing in size all the while: Instead of defeating Waximus, it is also possible to pass through the room, simply by lighting the two braziers by the door leading deeper into the mine.
Ol' Gail is an Arathi located in Beledar's Bounty, and later Lothar's Landing, in Hallowfall.

Ol' Chrome is a bronze dragon who appears as a gnome, found in Thaldraszus during the Dawn of the Infinite quest chain. She is an alternate timeline version of Chromie who was brought to the main timeline by Morchie.

]] Old Chain Link is fished up from the lake at in Transborea in eastern Borean Tundra near some Distracting Wisps. Players are directed there during The Trail's Gone Cold, part of Guest Relations. Players can also fish up A Gnome Effigy and some Rusted Engineering Parts. The gnome effigy and Link brings to mind Linken from the It's a Secret to Everybody questline in classic Un'Goro Crater. Linken was based at a tree by Marshal's Refuge. Head to to loot the Inert Peculiar Key from the tree trunk with the Torch of Pyrreth equipped. This is part of the process to acquire Incognitro, the Indecipherable Felcycle.

Om'talad is a broker located in the Oasis in K'aresh. Om'talad is one of the brokers to place bets on Slateback Alpha races with adventurers at The Oasis. He is an eager scientist willing to spend hours talking and educating anyone willing to listen about the complexities of how the eco-domes in Project Eco-Dome function.
On a Technicality concludes the optional chapter of the same name of the Ghosts of K'aresh campaign. Find Associate Xy'nell outside the Xy Imports Offices in northeast Tazavesh to begin.

Om'talad is a broker located in the Naakroa in K'aresh. Along with Om'musa and Om'baladh, she was sent by Cartel Om to install an echo machine in the ruins to study the long-dead flora of K'aresh. After installing the machine, she and Om'baladh were forced by Issam the Unraveler to modify it into a weapon that could sabotage all of the brokers' network across K'aresh. When killing Issam failed to shut down the machine, she asked an adventurer to unwrap her so she could shield them with her energy while they turned off the machine. Afterwards, she faded away.

On a Bed of Bones They Lie concludes the 19 August 2025 chapter of the Ecological Succession storyline. The next quest, and next chapter of the campaign, starts in the second half of the week of 19 August 2025 with Slateback Soccer from Om'talad.

Ollie Spracknozzle is a goblin located on Steamwheedle Laboratories in the Vatworks in Undermine. Ollie used to work with Skaggit when he was a union head at an unnamed mine. Later, Skaggit began working for Gazlowe and mentioned Ollie to him several times in the positive. Years later, Ollie, still working at the mine, spoke with Monte Gazlowe and wondered why he was here. The two discussed problems, with Gazlowe's goal being to improve the goblins' way, and worked on the Rockchomper. This prompted Marin Noggenfogger to let Ollie know that workers who had gotten hurt would be taken care of.

One Rank Higher is the first in a series of Liberation of Undermine achievements involving hard mode on the One-Armed Bandit boss. Only this achievement is required for the meta, Glory of the Liberation of Undermine Raider. Subsequent achievements in the series are just for bragging rights. There are four colored chips found inside the Gallagio while on the way to the One-Armed Bandit. After collecting one (or more) coins, take them to the slot machines in the room immediately before the boss arena and interact with the same-colored machine to deposit the coin and alter the encounter. Opportunity Point is the southernmost quest hub of the Ringing Deeps. The area (and elevator to the Orecreg up on the Isle of Dorn!) has been occupied by goblins of Opportunity Acquisitions, who work for Jastor Gallywix. The Opportunity Point Spa and Resort is bordered by the Ancient Falls to the north, the Deepforge Golemworks to the northwest, the Abyssal Excavation to the west, and the Lightless Chasm to the south. The Opportunity Point Amble skyriding race is located at just north of town.

Opportunity Acquisitions is a goblin organization which began mining operations in the Ringing Deeps. Renzik, Monte Gazlowe, Orweyna, and the adventurer discovered that Opportunity Acquisitions worked for Jastor Gallywix, the former leader of Gazlowe's Bilgewater Cartel. Unlike Gazlowe, Renzik was not surprised by this revelation, telling Gazlowe that Gallywix had been making new deals while Bilgewater wasn't paying attention.

Optional crafting reagents allow players to customize crafted gear by modifying its item level, secondary stats, or applying special effects. These reagents are not required for crafting but provide additional flexibility. The slot names cover a certain type of optional reagent. This article lists the different types and their relevant items.

The Opera of Malediction is a boss encounter found on the upper level of the Tomb of the Unrepentant in the Karazhan Crypts. The event changes each day and will be either the Ugly Goblin, Hans and Greta, or Trizivast. To begin the event, speak to Edgar and give him the Opera Ticket that drops from The Gravekeeper.
The Opera Ticket drops from The Gravekeeper in the Karazhan Crypts. It can be used to start the Opera of Malediction event in the Tomb of the Unrepentant.
